'''MultiPhase sound''' was a standard feature installed in [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. A trademarked system, MultiPhase sound was advertised in the marketing materials for the R2-series at no extra cost.<ref name="RPG" />
